description: Deterministic offline robustness perturbations of the frozen dashboard_v3 test split. Briefs are transformed by src.data_pipeline.perturbations (meaning-preserving synonym paraphrase / information drop); the gold recommendation is copied unchanged and item_id is preserved so the robustness metrics can pair original vs perturbed predictions. No LLM, no network, no randomness.
seed_note: Recorded for provenance only: the perturbations are rule-based and contain no randomness, so the output is identical for any seed.
